semantic_findings.finding: the five-source arbiter is not a uniform six-way mux: each payload field folds differently (full pass-through, single-bit gated, missing slot 5, slot-2-only paddr, Q-forced tail size, zero pftType for replays, collapsed noQuery)
evidence: LoadUnitS0.sv/Arbiter7_LoadStageIO.sv: 43 distinct assign shapes for the 43 payload fields
the directed per-field sweep compares all 43 fields for every source and every payload shape
semantic_findings.impact: a naive 'always take the winner payload' model would match only 26 of 43 fields

semantic_findings.finding: exceptionVec/uncacheReplay/ncReplay have no slot-5 arm and fall back to the (gated) slot-3 payload
evidence: Arbiter7_LoadStageIO.sv: in_3_valid & io_in_3_bits_* is the last arm for those fields
when slot 5 wins, slot 3 is necessarily invalid, so the result is 0 - the test asserts the zero value
semantic_findings.impact: no leak because the priority relation makes the two conditions exclusive
